en:
The culprit stopped the <CLT=cltSTRONG>video camera<CLT=cltNORMAL>
at the same time as the hydraulic press.

Then, while the camera was off, they
switched the body under the hydraulic press.

After the body was swapped, the press
and the camera were started simultaneously.

So it just looks like the press stopped
for a moment.
That's what I've been saying this whole time!
When did you ever say that?

So they stopped at the same time...
The camera position did seem odd to me...

But now I get it. The trick wouldn't 
work unless it was set up there.
...Huh? Why?

To get the trick we just described to work,
the camera had to be set up precisely.

<CLT=cltMIND>Let's pin that down.
Where was the camera set up...?
It was set up over there...

If it was there, the angle would be 
wrong and you couldn't control the press.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Maybe it was set up
right next to the press?

That would be a pretty close angle, but 
you couldn't press the switch from there.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Maybe it was set up
above the press?

I don't think you'd be able to record
the hydraulic press well from that angle...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Maybe it was set up
to the side of the press?

That would be a pretty close angle, but 
you couldn't press the switch from there.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Maybe it was set up
across from the press?

Umm, I think the angle would be wrong
there. Also you couldn't hit the switch.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Maybe it was set up
to the side of the press?

Umm, I think the angle would be wrong
there. Also you couldn't hit the switch.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Maybe it was set up
on one of the Exisals?

That's pretty far away. You wouldn't
be able to stop both at the same time.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Huh? Wait, so where was it?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Where was the camera set up?

The video camera must have been
set up somewhere around here.

To operate the press and the camera at the
same time, it would have to be near the switch.

That's why the video was taken from that
unnatural angle.

If they were recording it like normal,
they would've used a better angle.

And if it was recorded at such an odd angle,
then that proves a trick was used.

Camera angles, huh? Looks like your
cosplayer experience is finally useful.

Well, cosplay doesn't really come
up all that much in class trials...

There was a reason the camera was set up
there, but also a reason for the height.

When the press was stopped, you couldn't
really see who was inside it, correct?

That was intentional. The body is mostly
hidden by the press, making the swap easier.

The camera must've been placed at such a
high position so it would produce that angle.

I wonder if they used that tripod in the 
hangar to adjust the camera's height.

Did they get that from the warehouse, too?
Geez, that place is like a 4D pocket!
You don't get to make that reference...
Then...that logic is correct, right?

Kokichi used that video angle trick, and
switched the victim in the hydraulic press.
In that case, Kaito is—

Before he was crushed by the press,
he was swapped with a different body!
So Kaito's still alive!
Well, wait just a minute...
What!? But I just summed it up so nicely!

Himiko, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>different body<CLT=cltNORMAL> you mentioned...
What are you talking about?

The bodies from the other cases.
Kokichi's the mastermind, so he'd—
Nyeh...? Wait... The mastermind...?
Yeah. Kokichi isn't the mastermind, so...

...I don't think he'd be able to produce a body
to switch out.
...What?

Well, Monokuma? Do the rules allow for
a body to be reused?
Very well, I'll answer that.
...You're giving in pretty easily.

Well, it's crucial information to make the
trial fair.

This discussion is pointless if it's not clear
what the culprit was allowed to do, right?

Ah-haha, you're a convenient mastermind. But
I guess that makes defeating you worth my time.
Now then, regarding the re-use of a dead body...

That is <CLT=cltSTRONG>impossible<CLT=cltNORMAL>! All the dead bodies
have already been thrown away!
Th-Thrown away!?

The other bodies are...gone?
Then who did Kaito switch places with?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi and Kaito were the only ones
in the hangar at that time.

<CLT=cltMIND>If they were the only ones present
during the body-swapping trick...
<CLT=cltMIND>Then the real victim was...
The third party

<CLT=cltMIND>...No, the shutter was closed by then.
Maki couldn't have gotten in.
<CLT=cltMIND>There's no possiblity it was a third party.

If there were no other bodies...then how
the hell...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't believe it either...
but that's the only possibility.<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The mastermind

<CLT=cltMIND>It couldn't have been the mastermind,
or we wouldn't be in this trial right now.

There were only two people in the hangar...
Kaito...and Kokichi...

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't believe it either...
but that's the only possibility.<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The other person in the hangar

Shuichi...
Who did Kaito switch places with?

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't believe it either...
but that's the only possibility.<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>The two people who switched
places in the hydraulic press...

<CLT=cltMIND>If it wasn't an old body,
it could only be...

...What's wrong, Shuichi?
Who did Kaito switch places with?

Maki...I think I missed something
very important here...
...Something important?

<CLT=cltMIND>If I have the timeline right, there were
only two people in the hangar at the time.

<CLT=cltMIND>Which means that something
had to have been decided before...

<CLT=cltMIND>I have to pin that down.
Can't let anything escape me this time!
